verdict.rationale: Mistral documents official Python and TypeScript SDKs (installable via `pip install mistralai`) and its own Agents API, and its docs index includes an MCP page. These give first-class SDK support for building agent workflows. However, nothing in the pack shows official integrations into third-party coding agents or agent frameworks: no plugins, no skills, and no framework adapters. The MCP entry is only a generic description of the protocol. missing for 10: documented official integrations with third-party coding agents/agent frameworks, plugins or skills packages, concrete MCP integration details, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the model into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, official integrations — skills, plugins, or first-class SDK support

citations.quote: We provide official SDK clients in both Python and Typescript, you can also find third-party non-official SDKs in other languages.
AI agents autonomously execute tasks using LLMs, with tools, state persistence, and multi-agent collaboration via the Agents API
